verdict.rationale: Replit has a dedicated first-party docs page for adding a custom domain (add-custom-domain.md), with a worked example moving an app from velocity.replit.app to velocityrentals.com. It builds on the documented publishing flow, where a production deployment runs at its own URL. Missing for 10: details of the DNS/verification steps, SSL/HTTPS provisioning, plan or tier requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration that domain connection works.
